title: Education and learning stories vs hands-on making stories on hits
question: Does a story about education and learning reach ten points more often than a story about hands-on making?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about education and learning reaches ten points more often than a story about hands-on making.
expect: If true, share of stories that reach ten points for education and learning stories should be at least 1.5x the value for hands-on making stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: share of stories that reach ten points, education and learning against hands-on making

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h346 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h346 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
